## iOS: CYLLiquidGlass

| 中文 | English |
|:--|:--|
| CocoaPods pod 与 Swift Package 库 `CYLLiquidGlass`（`import CYLLiquidGlass`，Objective-C：`@import CYLLiquidGlass;`），iOS 15 起，同仓库同版本。 | CocoaPods pod and Swift package library `CYLLiquidGlass` (`import CYLLiquidGlass`, Objective-C: `@import CYLLiquidGlass;`), iOS 15 and later, same repository and version. |
| `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()`：系统是否使用液态玻璃：iOS 27 及以上总是；iOS 26 上 App 未设置 `UIDesignRequiresCompatibility` 时；更早的系统为 false。只读取一次。TabBar 的 `CYLUtils.isLiquidGlassActive()` 转发到它，接口不变。 | `CYLLiquidGlass.isActive()`: whether the system draws Liquid Glass: iOS 27 and later always; iOS 26 unless the app sets `UIDesignRequiresCompatibility`; false on earlier systems. Read once. The tab bar's `CYLUtils.isLiquidGlassActive()` forwards to it, its API unchanged. |
| `CYLLiquidGlassView`：任意视图的玻璃背景，`UIVisualEffectView` + `UIGlassEffect`；`glassTintColor` 着色，`cornerRadius` 裁剪；不接收触摸、对辅助功能隐藏。`isGlassDrawn` 为 false（无玻璃的系统）时不绘制，调用方保持扁平背景。 | `CYLLiquidGlassView`: a glass background for any view, a `UIVisualEffectView` with a `UIGlassEffect`; `glassTintColor` tints it and `cornerRadius` clips it; it takes no touches and is hidden from accessibility. When `isGlassDrawn` is false (a system without glass) it draws nothing and the caller keeps its flat background. |
| 测试：`CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` 替换系统判断。 | Tests: `CYLLiquidGlass.activeOverride` replaces the system check. |

```swift
import CYLLiquidGlass

let glass = CYLLiquidGlassView()
glass.glassTintColor = UIColor.systemOrange.withAlphaComponent(0.4)
glass.cornerRadius = 12
glass.frame = tagView.bounds
tagView.insertSubview(glass, at: 0)
if !glass.isGlassDrawn {
    tagView.backgroundColor = .systemOrange   // the flat fallback
}
```
